paragraphs: Fermi Inc's stock price is 6.31, with a 4.64% change from the prior close and a -23.14% change over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of August 4, 2026.

Recent news includes reports of Cetera Investment Advisers raising its stock position in Fermi Inc by 3,262.3% during the 1st quarter, and the company expecting to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year. There are also reports of a $375M convertible note deal and major product safety concerns, which have led to investor anxiety and a drop in stock price.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
